title: Plural affirmative-to-negative transformations
focus: Change olemme, olette, or ovat into emme ole, ette ole, or eivät ole while keeping the subject and context.

exercises.prompt: Change Te olette siellä nyt. “You are there now.” → ____ “You are not there now.” Keep the subject and context unchanged.
exercises.explanation: Te changes from olette to ette ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.

Correct. Te changes from olette to ette ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.
“He eivät ole siellä nyt.” does not fit this subject or construction. Te changes from olette to ette ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.
“Te ei olette siellä nyt.” does not fit this subject or construction. Te changes from olette to ette ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: subject + person-marked negative verb + ole + context

parts.role: subject: the person or people described by the sentence
parts.formation: subject pronoun; no ending is added

parts.role: negative verb: carries the person agreement
parts.formation: te takes the negative-verb form ette

parts.role: main verb after the negative verb
parts.formation: olla uses the fixed form ole after the negative verb

parts.role: context: tells the location or state
parts.formation: Use the complete taught form; no change is required
